inicio.title: COMITIA | Secure and scalable electoral technology
inicio.desc: COMITIA provides secure, auditable electronic voting platforms adapted to elections around the world.

bue.title: BUE | Secure and auditable electronic ballot | COMITIA
bue.desc: Electronic ballot system with printing and RFID chip that ensures transparency, accuracy and control in electoral processes.

notebox.title: Notebox | Real-time polling station management | COMITIA
notebox.desc: Electoral management system that assists polling station officials with real-time information, biometrics and faster, safer and more efficient processes.

turing.title: Turing | Real-time election results | COMITIA
turing.desc: Electoral transmission system that digitizes tally sheets and validates results in real time with AI, reducing errors and ensuring transparency and security.

invote.title: Secure and verifiable online voting | Invote COMITIA
invote.desc: Online voting system that allows remote voting with security, privacy and full verification of the electoral process.

soe.title: Electoral information and online training | SOE COMITIA
soe.desc: Electoral information and training solutions with platforms to educate voters, train officials and publish results.

eos.title: Electoral Operations System | Real-time management COMITIA
eos.desc: Platform to manage and monitor electoral processes in real time with traceability, control and centralized data.
